classification_scope: All-TSE, multi-year historical signal research from 2022 onward, free/no-contract sources with repeatable ordinary-runtime use, among officially documented sources reviewed.
not_a_universal_claim: This does not prove that no free source exists anywhere. A newly identified source can reopen the classification after actual coverage, permissions, history, and repeatability are verified.
constraints: No external data subscription or contract
No Codex/LLM dependency in eventual data collection or production
No automated scraping absent source permission

local_artifacts.raw_intraday_or_legacy_4h_export: Not present in the research worktree
local_artifacts.consequence: No real hourly-vs-daily consistency distributions, legacy 4h gap counts, or fresh session-bar backtest results can be stated.

existing_runtime_observation.source: Read-only inspection of weekly_report_gas documentation and GAS source
existing_runtime_observation.path: Yahoo 1-hour requests -> AM/PM aggregation -> legacy ohlcv_4h
existing_runtime_observation.scope: Current feed is tied to signal/repair workflows; all-TSE multi-year research coverage is unestablished.
existing_runtime_observation.qualification: This proves recent 1-hour-derived AM/PM values are produced in ordinary GAS. It does not prove feed permission, full coverage, accuracy, or multi-year historical data.

provider_review.finding: Official plan table describes free daily OHLC with a 12-week delay; official 2026 enhancement says minute/tick is a paid add-on from Light or higher. Fails the no-cost intraday requirement.
Official docs list 4h interval, but Basic describes global trial symbols and 8 API credits/minute, 800/day; all-TSE, delisted, and multi-year free intraday coverage is not established.
Intraday documentation offers historical depth but labels TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY as a premium endpoint.

Current project code uses Yahoo 1h through ordinary GAS and documents 365-day retention for the derived legacy bars. Official terms prohibit automated collection without express prior permission. No permission evidence or all-TSE multi-year raw panel is in the research worktree.

daily_reconciliation.reporting_limit: Daily-vs-hourly comparisons measure provider-internal consistency and do not establish which side is ground truth.
daily_reconciliation.allowed_supplement: Validate full-day summary or use time-valid daily close/context; never infer per-session extremes or pre-close information.

hybrid_assessment.hypothesis: Daily broad-universe candidate generation plus recent session-aligned intraday reranking could lower retrieval burden.
gates: Measure eligible intraday-source coverage and missingness for every requested key.
Verify timestamps, adjustment basis, and Codex-free reproducibility.
Compare daily-only, intraday-only, and reconciled variants on the identical candidate pool and endpoint.

next_required_inputs: Read-only export of legacy ohlcv_4h values for the requested gap inventory.
Raw 1-hour or finer OHLCV export with timestamp interval semantics for an independent rebuild and daily-consistency audit.
